draftingProhibitedBecause: Adopted packet instruction on this track: “YES — STAGED OFFICIAL-FORM PACKET. OCA MMRTA Form A is expressly designed for the currently-serving posture. That posture is a scope restriction and a substantive-choice warning, not a reason to downgrade the mechanism to guidance.” The Montana state pack records the same: Montana provides official self-represented packets, so these map to official forms rather than a custom pleading.
blockingStatement: The binary is retained and hashed, but no PDF/DOCX field map and no overlay exist for it. The Montana state pack states plainly: “no PDF field map exists yet and no renderer is wired.” Nothing can be produced from this component until the field map exists.
